label: AU Energy Rating
definition: Australia and New Zealand star-based energy label (more stars = more efficient)

label: EU Energy Label
definition: European Union A-G scale energy label

label: UK Energy Label
definition: United Kingdom A-G scale energy label

label: Energy Star
definition: North American efficiency programme; membership is an evidence-gated claim

label: AU WELS Water Rating
definition: Australian water-efficiency star label (water not energy; grouped with rating schemes)

label: SG Energy Label
definition: Singapore tick-based energy label (1-5 ticks) under the NEA Mandatory Energy Labelling Scheme

label: JP Energy Label
definition: Japan Uniform Energy-Saving Labelling programme star label showing achievement against METI Top Runner targets

label: CN Energy Label
definition: China mandatory energy information label with efficiency grades 1-5 (grade 1 most efficient)
